answer: Because the falcon lockup is upheld by the haven escrow, the jetty audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large swarm thus freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants forfeit once per identity. The bond is locked for 39 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. That is 9 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
